items.description: Additional files to be appended to the document. Will not replace existing files from the template. Document files can be uploaded by specifying a file URL or base64 string. Either `file_url` or `file_base64` must be present (not both). Valid file types are: .pdf, .docx, .jpg, .png, .ppt, .xls, .pages, and .txt.

name.description: Name of the file that will be uploaded.

file_url.description: Publicly available URL of the file to be uploaded.

file_base64.description: A RFC 4648 base64 string of the file to be uploaded.
